results.question: 删除某客户的所有订单
修改企业客户的订单数据
各等级客户的交易笔数排名
results.sql: SELECT c.level, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.user_id = c.id GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 各品类商品卖出件数排名
results.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_qty FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 所有客户的订单数（含未下单客户）
results.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS 订单数 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.user_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name LIMIT 1000

results.question: 所有商品的销量统计（含未售出商品）
results.sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity),0) AS 销量 FROM products p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name LIMIT 1000

results.question: 消费金额超过平均值的客户有哪些
results.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.user_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING SUM(o.amount) > (SELECT AVG(customer_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS customer_total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) t) LIMIT 1000

results.question: 销量超过平均销量的商品有哪些
results.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING SUM(o.quantity) > (SELECT AVG(product_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS product_total FROM orders GROUP BY product_id) t) ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 订单数超过100的客户等级
results.sql: SELECT c.level, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.user_id = c.id GROUP BY c.level HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 LIMIT 1000

results.question: 销售额超过10万的商品品类
results.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS 销售额 FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category HAVING SUM(o.amount) > 100000 LIMIT 1000

results.question: 消费金额最高的前3个客户
results.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.user_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: 销售额排名前5的商品品类
results.sql: SELECT p.category AS 商品品类, SUM(o.amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: 上个月企业客户的订单数
